evidence.summary: list_clip: 'IdleBreatheWeightShift: 5 keyframes, length 6.000s, loop=true, priority=Idle'. Keyframe dump: neutral at t=0/3/6, weight-shift left at t=1.5 (UpperTorso roll +5, left knee +4, ankle -4), mirrored right at t=4.5; all foot/HRP positions (0,0,0) in every key; probe printed 'LOOP MATCH: IDENTICAL first/last'. Filmstrips (front/right/iso, 8-10 frames) show subtle alternating torso lean + arm drift, feet planted identically in all frames, ending pose == start pose.

reasons: Filmstrip reads as a natural gentle idle: visible breathing/arm drift and alternating left/right weight shift with torso lead
No foot-slide: feet planted at identical positions in all frames and all keyframe Pose positions are zero
Seamless loop verified structurally: first and last keyframes identical per joint, Loop=true
Config matches artifact: 5 keyframes, Idle priority, clip name correct
Amplitudes 1-8 degrees over 6s = gentle arc; Linear easing produces no visible pops at this scale

steps: authored 5 keyposes with pose_joint + add_keyframe at t=0/1.5/3/4.5/6s
set Loop=true, Priority=Idle on the KeyframeSequence
capture_animation 8-frame filmstrip to verify motion + seamless loop

recipe.text: Full-body looped idle on an R15 block rig. Neutral base pose (slight Waist/Neck pitch, relaxed elbow bend, arms tucked ~2deg) keyed at t=0/3/6 identically for a seamless 6s loop. Breath inhale poses at t=1.5 (weight shifted onto LEFT leg: Waist roll +5, opposite Neck counter-roll, shoulders lift, LeftKnee/LeftAnkle soften 4deg) and t=4.5 (mirror: weight onto RIGHT leg, Waist roll -1..-2, RightKnee/RightAnkle soften). Feet never translate so no foot-slide; all deltas kept 2-8deg so the motion reads as gentle breathing + sway, not fidgeting.
